## Answer

In **miniml's local harness-bench**, the coding harness **`pi`** ranked first overall with a **76.9% pass rate** (123/160 cells) and an average agent time of 163 s [1](https://neuralnoise.com/2026/harness-bench-wip/).

The **top cell** (best single model + harness combination) on the matrix was:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Combination** | Qwen3.6-27B (UD-Q4_K_XL) + `pi` |
| **Pass Rate** | **16/16 (100%)** |
| **Per-Task Time** | **~207 s/task** |

This was the only combination across all 85 tested cells to clear the full benchmark, described as the "single perfect cell on the matrix" [1](https://neuralnoise.com/2026/harness-bench-wip/).

For context, `pi` was characterized as "the strongest harness on this benchmark – and also the fastest of the top three," outperforming `qwen` (75.0%), `claude` (66.2%), `opencode` (63.8%), and `aider` (62.5%) [1](https://neuralnoise.com/2026/harness-bench-wip/).
